_comment: OpenCode Zen gateway. One credential reaches four wires; the catalog protocol hint (the Model's AI SDK package on models.dev) routes and admits every Model it names a known package for (today the Messages, Responses and Gemini Models), a rule routes and admits the reviewed Chat Completions Models the catalog names no package for, and a Model with neither is refused. Free Models serve only OpenCode itself (FreeTierError) and retired Models are refused before sending; discovery writes none of these refused Models. Messages carries images and PDFs with prompt-cache breakpoints; Chat Completions and Responses carry images only (Zen's converters establish no native document, audio or video forwarding there). Responses is stateless (store false) and takes only max_output_tokens and top_p. Gemini generateContent carries Gemini's inline media up to Zen's documented 20 MB request body and reasons at thinkingLevel; none asks for the lowest level.

Qwen3.8 Max on Chat switches thinking.type on or off, enabled by default, and answers with reasoning_content (verified 2026-09-28).
Zen forwards Messages to Anthropic, where these adaptive-only Models reject thinking type disabled (resources/wire/anthropic.json), so effort none sends no thinking field.
These Models always reason; none asks for the cheapest rung, low (GPT 6.1 Sol verified 2026-10-02, Space Bunny 2026-09-24).
GPT 6.1 Sol ignores historical Reasoning (verified 2026-10-02), so none is replayed.
